ownership.ordinary_text: Only model-generated assistant text; preserved verbatim. No host answer synthesis or repair.
ownership.policy: Caller-provided per-user-turn permit_calls/allowed_names; user content cannot grant authority.
ownership.dispatch: Existing tools.FixtureSession alone; formatter/parser never executes code or calls tools.
ownership.call_ids: Broker-owned c1..c4 session sequence, stored as history metadata and inside observed result.
ownership.results: Complete observed broker record, excluding volatile timestamp; no fabricated result replacement.

messages: {role:tool,call_id,record} continues the same open assistant turn
schema_contract.policies: List aligned exactly with user events; each {permit_calls:bool,allowed_names:list}. Omitted means calls disabled for general dialogue.
schema_contract.assistant_text: Native text between assistant_start and assistant_end; no JSON text envelope.
schema_contract.calls: python_start + canonical JSON {name,arguments} + python_end. Only calculate/convert schemas accepted.
schema_contract.results: output_start + canonical stable broker record + output_end.
schema_contract.fixed_tokens: Existing python_start/end IDs are REDEFINED as JSON transport delimiters, never Python instructions. No new vocabulary IDs.
schema_contract.host_policy_placement: Masked ordinary text inside each user frame. Initial system text included only in the first user frame because the frozen tokenizer has no system-role token.

loss_contract.normalization: SFT trainer must sum assistant-target losses and divide by total valid targets across accumulated microbatches; not implemented by formatter.

generation_contract: Before a new assistant turn: shared renderer appends assistant_start. After a broker result: continue after output_end without a second assistant_start.
Stop decoding on assistant_end for final text, or python_end for a proposal. A call is one action, not the completed user turn.
parse_generated returns text/call/invalid; unsupported names, malformed or duplicate JSON fields, missing arguments and partial frames remain invalid.
Parser acceptance is not authorization. Apply live broker policy/quotas even when parser says call; record broker error instead of inventing an answer.
Never use upstream nanochat.engine automatic calculator/Python handling for this stream. A dedicated broker-aware generation loop remains to be implemented.
Always rerender typed history through this formatter. JSON normalization changes whitespace/key ordering only; if generated call bytes differed, invalidate/rebuild any KV cache before continuation.
Literal special-token spellings in user/system/result/text content use ordinary BPE IDs, not control IDs.
No truncation or silent history dropping. Reject overflow before training/inference; a future explicit whole-turn history policy requires separate tests.

coverage: assistant call supervision and fullymasked brokerresult

remaining_gates: Actual broker-aware model serving loop and KV-cache behavior
SFT dataset mapping/filtering and execution replay admission
Model-driven conversation/tool acceptance; pure formatting tests do not establish learned behavior
